name: Boon Of Blazing Dawn
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Beloved of the Sun
features.description: You have Immunity to Radiant damage.

features.name: Blazing Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the damage can be Radiant or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice).

features.name: Burst of Sunlight
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Radiant damage, you can emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius from yourself and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet until the start of your next turn. This light is sunlight.
